设计意图： Blended momentum weighting by volatility ratio. Instead of a binary switch based on residual volatility regime, this factor continuously blends 10-day and 40-day momentum using the ratio of recent volatility (20-day rolling std of returns) to its 20-day EMA. When volatility is elevated (ratio > 1), more weight is given to the longer 40-day momentum to filter noise; when volatility is low, the fast

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义

ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  3. 计算 vol：ret.滚动窗口(20).std()
  4. 计算 vol_ema：vol.ewm(span=20).mean()
  5. 计算 vol_ratio：vol / vol_ema
  6. 计算 weight_long：np.clip(vol_ratio, 0, 1)
  7. 计算 roc10：close.pct_change(10)
  8. 计算 roc40：close.pct_change(40)
  9. 计算 factor：weight_long * roc40 + (1 - weight_long) * roc10
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volatility_blended_momentum(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] ret = close.pct_change() vol = ret.rolling(20).std() vol_ema = vol.ewm(span=20).mean() vol_ratio = vol / vol_ema.replace(0, np.nan) weight_long = np.clip(vol_ratio, 0, 1) roc10 = close.pct_change(10) roc40 = close.pct_change(40) factor = weight_long * roc40 + (1 - weight_long) * roc10 df_copy["str">'factor_volatility_blended_momentum'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_volatility_blended_momentum']
